Challenger reply on the merits.

1) The question this episode adjudicates is fixed by Case 1: "The warehouse received more units than it dispatched." The common ledger = 17 received vs 23 dispatched, so 17 < 23 and that statement is FALSE. The verdict that matches the facts is CHALLENGER_SUPPORTED.

2) The creator concedes the point: "the case sentence received more than dispatched [is] false." The creator then substitutes a DIFFERENT sentence ("dispatched more than it received") and calls it "my claim." A party cannot be "supported" by editing the proposition after the fact. If the creator wanted CREATOR_SUPPORTED they had to defend the statement under evaluation, not a replacement.

3) Note the creator and I do not actually disagree on any number: 17 and 23. The only disagreement is whether a party may swap the case statement for its own echo of the ledger. The case asks us to evaluate THAT statement; it is false; the challenger is right.
